name: South Dakota

response.rule_text: Officer must respond no later than ten business days after receipt (SDCL 1-27-37(1)); failure to respond or meet the stated time estimate is a deemed denial (1-27-37(5)).

fees.labor_rule: Staff time chargeable in excess of one hour (SDCL 1-27-35).
fees.copy_rule: Actual cost of mailing/transmittal and reproduction, or fees set by statute (1-27-35).
fees.waiver_rule: Fee may be waived or reduced if in the public interest (1-27-36).
fees.estimate_required: Required for informal requests likely to exceed $50; requester must confirm in writing (1-27-36).
fees.late_penalty: Civil penalty up to $50 per day for unreasonable bad-faith denials (1-27-40.2).

residency.rule_text: Access extends to all citizens of this state and all other persons interested (SDCL 1-27-1).

appeal.body: Circuit court, or Office of Hearing Examiners
appeal.rule_text: File civil action in circuit court within ninety days of the denial, or request review by the Office of Hearing Examiners by certified mail (SDCL 1-27-38); entity responds in ten business days (1-27-39); 30 days to comply or appeal after an order (1-27-40.1).

format_rule: Records kept in original or searchable reproducible format (1-27-4); requester cannot choose a format per RCFP.
notes: Read chars 0-100k only; all fields from that chunk. Governor records have special handling (1-27-1.19 to 1-27-1.21); Unified Judicial System excluded (1-27-1.12). Universities only mentioned for student/research exemptions. Clarification not answered in 10 business days is deemed withdrawn. 90 days unit assumed calendar.
